import 'package:context/context.dart';

void main() {
  final key = ContextKey<int>('count');
  final ContextBinding<int> binding = key.bind(42);
  final Context context = Context().withBinding(binding);
  final int? optional = context.read(key);
  final int required = context.require(key);
  if (optional != 42 || required != 42) throw StateError('Incorrect binding');
  try {
    context.require(ContextKey<String>('absent'));
    throw StateError('Missing binding was accepted');
  } on MissingContextValue catch (error) {
    if (error.debugName != 'absent') rethrow;
  }
}
